visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a man in a white shirt and black face mask holding a camera in a selfie perspective, walking through an outdoor campus parking area with a woman wearing a white top and long black hair beside him. (2) A static shot displays a tall white pillar with the words '天主教 輔仁大學 FU JEN CATHOLIC UNIVERSITY' engraved in black, followed by the couple walking away from the camera along a shaded campus path with green trees and a grey backpack visible on the man's back. (3) The scene shifts to close-ups of various vegan food items, including a mushroom baguette sandwich and skewers topped with strawberries and shredded vegetables, interspersed with shots of the woman smiling brightly in a sunlit outdoor setting. (4) A product montage begins, showing the man and woman jumping joyfully on a grassy field, then showcasing a series of grey and white bags including a backpack, a tote bag, and a laptop sleeve against a white studio background with graphic text overlays. (5) Detailed close-up shots emphasize the texture of the white synthetic leather material of the bags and the man carrying the backpack while walking through a park, followed by the woman twirling with a tote bag in a field. (6) The video transitions to several food court and restaurant locations where the woman is shown eating a bowl of noodles with a savory sauce and the couple reacting to a large bowl of vegetarian stew filled with various toppings. (7) A close-up sequence depicts the preparation of a traditional tofu dessert with syrup and toppings, then shows the man wearing a helmet and adjusting a crossbody bag while standing outdoors near a building. (8) The final sequence highlights more food dishes like a vegetable sandwich and a soy milk drink, ending with the couple eating unique grilled stinky tofu skewers topped with strawberries at a night market stall with a red lantern in the background.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video moves between a sunlit university campus with trees and modern buildings, brightly lit indoor restaurants and food courts, an open grassy park area, and a bustling night market with red lanterns.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy male voice speaking Traditional Chinese over a bright, upbeat electronic pop track featuring a steady 4/4 drum beat and synthesizer chords. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect punctuates the transition as the narrator explains the couple's plan to revisit their university, with the music maintaining a consistent, joyful energy. (3) Soft rustling sounds of fabric are heard at approximately 14 seconds as the narrator discusses the texture of the backpack, followed by another 'whoosh' transition effect into the food segment. (4) During the food segments, the narrator's tone becomes more exaggerated and comedic, accompanied by the clinking of ceramic bowls and occasional slurping or chewing sounds as they taste the noodles and stew. (5) A distinct mechanical 'zip' sound occurs at 50 seconds when the narrator highlights the compartments of the crossbody bag, with the BGM continuing at a steady tempo in the background. (6) The sizzle of a grill is briefly audible at 1:09 as the camera shows stinky tofu being cooked, and the narrator's vocal arousal peaks as he encourages viewers to try the unique dish before the music swells and then fades into silence at the very end.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote Volvo's 'Nordico' series of eco-friendly bags by integrating them into a relatable lifestyle vlog centered on a 'memory lane' food tour of Fu Jen Catholic University. It combines nostalgic storytelling about a 10-year relationship with high-energy food reviews to appeal to young adults interested in fashion and local cuisine.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The narrator explicitly names the brand 'VOLVO', highlights specific product features like recycled materials and storage compartments, and displays the brand logo in text overlays.
